model.title: A bill to reauthorize the Terrorism Risk Insurance Act of 2002, and for other purposes.
model.meta: Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs Committee · Sen. David McCormick (R-PA)

summary.text: The bill would extend the Terrorism Risk Insurance Act, which helps ensure that property and casualty insurance remains available and affordable for businesses and property owners in the event of a terrorist attack. It aims to continue the federal government's backstop program that protects insurers from catastrophic losses due to terrorism while maintaining a sustainable insurance market.
